name: Will repairing a drywall crack prevent it from reappearing?

mainEntity.name: Will repairing a drywall crack prevent it from reappearing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a drywall crack will provide a smooth, finished surface, but whether it prevents recurrence depends on addressing the underlying cause. If the crack was due to minor house settling, a proper repair using flexible materials can often prevent it from reappearing for a long time. However, if the cause is ongoing structural movement, persistent moisture issues, or seismic activity, the crack may reappear over time without addressing the root problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing a drywall crack can prevent recurrence if the underlying cause is addressed. If not, especially with ongoing structural issues, it may reappear.
